opening.argument: The walkthrough shows a Vanilla Mastercard gift card beside a phone displaying the card-management page, including a balance and an Assign ZIP Code section. The speaker identifies activation and registration as the subject, then explains how to check the balance and set a ZIP code for online or gas-station use. Those are practical instructions for managing the card. The Cash App referral in the description is separate from the gift-card walkthrough; it does not make payment or use of a referral code a condition of following the instructions. Nothing in the cited material establishes a deceptive condition or a required payment flow tied to the tutorial.
